caption: The drawing consists of three vertical panels arranged side by side, each containing a single, stylized figure. The background of all three panels is textured with a muted blue color. In the left panel, there is an orange, tree-like figure with multiple branching arms extending outward, and two eye-like shapes near the center. The middle panel contains another orange figure, similar in structure to the first, but with additional horizontal red lines crossing the main vertical axis. The right panel features a red outline of a humanoid shape with elongated limbs, a rib-like pattern in the chest section, claw-like hands, and two upward-pointing horn-like structures on the head. The panels are separated by white vertical lines, and the overall composition is centered on a white background.
title: Petroglyph Design
